title: Move the five dataparade.io landing posts into the newsroom
description: Import landing/content/posts/*.mdx into the Data Parade newsroom as published articles with the same slugs, dates, authors and tags, so /posts/<slug> keeps working after the mount. Uses the import command if PPY backlog story lands, else targeted upserts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-21 (Ryan asked in the DataParade.anth.us thread): the five landing posts (DataParade-io/dataparade feat/posts, landing/content/posts/*.mdx) imported into the Data Parade newsroom with 'papyrus ops content import-markus' (PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam, papyrus-production, outputs of app d35q7zv4zad2we): created 5, published 5, same slugs, dates, tags and titles; the MDX author object became author: Ryan Porter. Dry run first, then applied; the full projection it scheduled wrote them. Live: dataparade.anth.us/posts/ lists all five and /posts/_data/latest.json carries them.
